description: This Java source file defines the 'AuthClient' class, providing utility methods for API authentication in testing scenarios for the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for cookie-based login and optional bearer token retrieval, accommodating different authentication modes used in API tests.

classes.name: AuthClient
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for API authentication using cookies and bearer tokens.

methods.name: loginWithCookies
methods.description: Performs a cookie-based login via the web login endpoint, returning authentication cookies or throwing an exception if login fails.

methods.name: bearerToken
methods.description: Retrieves an optional OAuth2 bearer token from system properties or environment variables, or returns a demo token in mock mode.
